scope: Retrospective full 129-case original published corpus, all 103 recorded latest answers. New explicit CWE title-identity diagnostic, not blinded semantic accuracy or vulnerability localization. No labels or case names used in policy.

known_names.829: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere

comparison.baseline: Registry ID exists (checks exact ID, not wording).
comparison.candidate: Same input and registry, detect only explicit code/title pairs where title exactly normalizes to another unique registry weakness name and differs from claimed ID. Otherwise abstain when title cannot be mapped; no security claim.
comparison.denominator: Report all 129 latest cases and all 103 answers; per explicit name pair count matches/conflicts/unresolved; report missing answers separately.
comparison.selection: Existing original records inspected before this protocol; no holdout claim. Freeze parser and complete census; no hand-picking mismatches.
